label: bp:foundation-pnt
title: A quantitative prime number theorem
statement: $\exists c>0:\ \psi(x)-x=O(xe^{-c(\log x)^{1/10}})$.
role: Analytic producer. Direct consumers: AnalyticNumberTheory.PrimeDistribution.chebyshevTheta_medium_error and AnalyticNumberTheory.PrimeDistribution.chebyshevTheta_error; the former retains the prime-power correction before Mertens partial summation.

label: bp:foundation-mertens
title: Mertens product with its identified constant
statement: $\exists C>0\ \forall n\ge2:\ |\prod_{p\le n}(1-1/p)-e^{-\gamma}/\log n|\le C/(\log n)^2$.
role: Analytic producer. Direct consumer: MathlibNt.SieveTheory.MertensTheorem.mertens_product_formula; the local product and singular-series normalizations sit above this facade, not above elementary error absorption.

label: bp:foundation-local-product
title: Uniform dimension-one Goldbach local product
statement: $\exists K>1:\ \prod_{p\in\mathcal P}(1-1/(p-1))^{-1}\le(\log z_2/\log z_1)(1+K/\log z_1)$ for every finite set of odd primes $\mathcal P\subset[z_1,z_2)$, $2\le z_1\le z_2$.
role: Analytic producer. Direct consumers: MathlibNt.SieveTheory.LiLiuOnePlusOneNine.GoldbachBig.exists_goldbachB10BoundingSieve_dimensionOneLocalProductBound and MathlibNt.SieveTheory.LiLiuOnePlusOneNine.GoldbachBig.exists_goldbachS2SwitchedBoundingSieve_dimensionOneLocalProductBound. Constants precede the varying source.

label: bp:foundation-bv
title: Bombieri–Vinogradov for primes
statement: For every $A>0$ there are $B\ge0$, $C>0$ and $N_0$ such that $\sum_{1\le q\le Q_B(N)}E^*(N,q)\le CN/(\log N)^A$ for integers $N\ge N_0$, where $Q_B(N)=\lfloor N^{1/2}/(\log N)^B\rfloor$ and $E^*(N,q)=\max_{y\in\{0,\ldots,N\}}\max_{0\le a<q,\,(a,q)=1}|\pi(y;q,a)-L_*(y)/\varphi(q)|$. Here $L_*(x)=2/\log2+\int_2^xdt/\log t$ for $x>1$, while $L_*(0)=L_*(1)=2/\log2$ by the totalized interval-integral convention, not a principal value; $E^*(N,0)=0$.
role: Unconditional distribution producer; L_*=2/log(2)+integral_2^x dt/log(t). Direct consumers: MathlibNt.SieveTheory.Bombieri1965RichertWeightedConsumer.chenWeightedBombieriVinogradov, MathlibNt.SieveTheory.JurkatRichert1965ChenRichertConsumer.chenBaseLowerAsymptotic, and MathlibNt.SieveTheory.LiLiuOnePlusOneNine.GoldbachBig.goldbachS1_beta_lower_paid.

label: bp:foundation-weighted-bv
title: The actual weighted conditioned Chen error
statement: For fixed $0<\epsilon<1/6$ and $A>0$, let $P_N=\prod_{2<p\le N^{1/10},\,p\nmid N}p$. Eventually, $\sum_{N^{1/10}<q\le N^{1/3},\ q\ \text{ prime},\ q\nmid N}\sum_{d\mid P_N,\ d<\lfloor N^{1/2-\epsilon}/q\rfloor+1}3^{\omega(d)}E_{\rm prime}(N,qd)\ll_{\epsilon,A}N/(\log N)^A$. The fixed-endpoint error is $E_{\rm prime}(N,h)=\max_{0\le a<h,\,(a,h)=1}|\pi(N;h,a)-L_*(N)/\varphi(h)|\le E^*(N,h)$; all products run over primes. The constants and threshold depend only on the fixed parameters.
role: Distribution producer for combined modulus q*d. Direct consumers: MathlibNt.SieveTheory.JurkatRichert1965ChenRichertConsumer.chenUpperInput (internal) and MathlibNt.SieveTheory.JurkatRichert1965ChenRichertConsumer.chenFacingSourceChainCertificate. Ordinary BV is requested at exponent 2*A+10; nonreduced corrections are separate.

label: bp:foundation-jr-hats
title: Constructed Jurkat--Richert comparison functions
statement: For the constructed Jurkat--Richert functions $F,f$, let $c_\gamma=2e^\gamma$. On $s>0$, define $\widehat T^+(s)=s^{-2}$ for $s\le3$ and $[F(s)-f(s-1)]/(c_\gamma s)$ for $s>3$; define $\widehat T^-(s)=2s^{-2}$ for $s\le2$ and $[F(s-1)-f(s)]/(c_\gamma s)$ for $s>2$. These positive extensions of the normalized derivatives $-F'/c_\gamma$ and $f'/c_\gamma$ satisfy the complete Suzuki source properties with $\widehat\beta=2$: positivity, continuity, the initial formulas, weighted delay derivatives, and weighted and exponential decay.
role: Analytic producer, not an assumed sieve theorem. Direct consumers include MathlibNt.SieveTheory.JurkatRichert1965ChenRichertConsumer.chenBaseLowerSieve and its private modernUpperDensity; MathlibNt.SieveTheory.LiLiuOnePlusOneNine.GoldbachBig.goldbachS1_beta_lowerDensity and private B10RosserFactor_modernUpperDensity / S2RosserFactor_modernUpperDensity.

label: bp:foundation-suzuki-lower
title: Lower Rosser comparison uniform in the sieve
statement: Fix hats satisfying the Suzuki source properties and real $d,\Delta,\Theta$ with $0<\Delta<1$, $d>7/(1-\Delta)$, $\Theta>0$, $2/d<1/\Theta$ and $2/\Theta+3/d<1-\Delta$. The source selects its auxiliary constants, and in particular $C\ge3$, before the bounding sieve $S$ varies. For each $K\ge2$ satisfying its dimension-one local-product bound, each integer $D\ge2$ and $4\le s\le6$, put $z=\lceil D^{1/s}\rceil\ge2$ and assume $s\le\sigma_{\rm src}(D;d)=(\log D)^{1/d}\log\log(27D)$. With $\mathcal P_S(z)$ the supported primes below $z$, $P=\prod_{p\in\mathcal P_S(z)}p$, $m=2(|\mathcal P_S(z)|+1)$ and $V_S(z)=\prod_{p\in\mathcal P_S(z)}(1-g_S(p))$, one has $V_S(z)[f(s)-C e^{\sqrt K}E_m(D,s;d)(\log D)^{-\Delta}]\le\sum_{e\mid P}\lambda_e^-g_S(e)$. The weights are the finite lower Rosser weights of natural level $D$, and $E_m(D,s;d)=(1+s^d/\log D)^s s\widehat T^{\eta_m}(s)$, with $\eta_m=+$ for odd $m$ and $-$ for even $m$.
role: Proved analytic implication, with explicit source hypotheses supplied by the constructed hats and parameters. Direct consumers: MathlibNt.SieveTheory.eventually_jurkatRichertSource_lowerDensity_of_section13HatSource and MathlibNt.SieveTheory.LiLiuOnePlusOneNine.GoldbachBig.goldbachS1_beta_lowerDensity. The error envelope is not omitted.

label: bp:foundation-suzuki-upper
title: Modern upper Rosser comparison
statement: Given hats satisfying the Suzuki source properties and fixed $d,\Delta,\Theta$ with $0<\Delta<1$, $d>7/(1-\Delta)$, $\Theta>0$, $2/d<1/\Theta$ and $2/\Theta+3/d<1-\Delta$, for every $K>1$ and $\rho>0$ there is $z_0$ before the bounding sieve $S$ varies. If $z\ge\max(2,z_0)$, $D_{\rm real}>0$, $S$ satisfies the dimension-one local-product bound with $K$, every sifting prime is at most $z$, and $s=\log D_{\rm real}/\log z\in[3/2,4]$, then $\sum_{e\mid P}\lambda_e^+g_S(e)\le(F(s)+\rho)\prod_{p\mid P}(1-g_S(p))$. Here $P$ is the product of the sifting primes, the product on the right is over primes, and $\lambda^+$ is the finite upper Rosser weight at natural level $\lfloor D_{\rm real}\rfloor+1$.
role: Proved comparison implication. Direct consumers: MathlibNt.SieveTheory.JurkatRichert1965ChenRichertConsumer.modernUpperDensity (internal), MathlibNt.SieveTheory.LiLiuOnePlusOneNine.GoldbachBig.B10RosserFactor_modernUpperDensity and MathlibNt.SieveTheory.LiLiuOnePlusOneNine.GoldbachBig.S2RosserFactor_modernUpperDensity (internal). Natural level is floor(D)+1.

label: bp:foundation-liupan
title: Liu--Pan distribution for the actual convolution
statement: $\exists\kappa\ \forall U>0\ \exists C>0,B\ge0,N_0:\ \sum_{q<N^{1/2}/(\log N)^B}M_{a_N,I_N,\kappa}(N;q)\le CN/(\log N)^U$ for $N\ge N_0$; the proof chooses $\kappa=2/\log2$.
role: Unconditional source-specific distribution producer. Direct consumers: MathlibNt.SieveTheory.LiuWeight.liuPanWangDingCorollary230_proved and MathlibNt.SieveTheory.LiuWeight.liuPanCanonicalCoprimeTheorem_proved. Source sum stays inside absolute value; low/high conductor, cofactor, and principal estimates are supplied internally.

label: bp:foundation-liupan-canonical
title: Liu–Pan convolution distribution
statement: $\forall\epsilon,A>0\ \exists C>0,B\ge0,N_0:$ the canonical $L_2$ coprime weighted remainder majorant is $\le CN/(\log N)^A$ for $N\ge N_0$.
role: Proved source/weight/normalization transport. Direct consumers: MathlibNt.ChensTheorem.chens_theorem_unconditional and MathlibNt.ChensTheorem.chen_good_representations_lower_bound_unconditional. This is an analytic input node, not either public Goldbach endpoint.

label: bp:foundation-pan-bounded
title: Pan distribution for varying weights
statement: $\forall U>0\ \exists C>0,B\ge0,N_0\ \forall N\ge N_0,I,a:\ \sum_{1\le q\le Q_B(N)}M_{a,I,*}(N;q)\le CN/(\log N)^U$, provided $|a|\le1$, $A_2\le N^{2/3}$, $(\log N)^{2B}\le A_1$.
role: Analytic producer for changing Li--Liu sources. Direct consumers: MathlibNt.SieveTheory.LiLiuOnePlusOneNine.GoldbachBig.goldbachS2SwitchedRemainder_log_saving and MathlibNt.SieveTheory.LiLiuOnePlusOneNine.GoldbachBig.goldbachB10PanPrefixRemainder_twoEndpoints_log_saving. Reuses low/high primitives but is not an instantiation of the fixed Chen coefficient theorem.

label: bp:foundation-selberg-denominator
title: Asymptotic of the optimized Selberg denominator
statement: $\epsilon<1/2\implies G(N,\epsilon)\mathfrak S_{\mathrm{Liu}}(N)/\log N\to(1/4-\epsilon/2)/2$ along the even integers.
role: Analytic producer. Direct consumer: MathlibNt.SieveTheory.LiuWeight.liuSelbergDenominatorLowerBound_of_lt_margin; then liuOptimizedSelbergCoefficientInput and eventually_liuSelbergOptimalLambda_mainTermUpperBound_even use the optimized denominator, with a separate prime-pair main mass.

label: bp:foundation-selberg-remainder
title: Paying the signed Selberg remainder
statement: $|\mathcal R_{\lambda}(N,\epsilon)|\le\mathcal M_{\mathrm{full}}(N,\epsilon)$ for $N\ge1$ and admissible supported $\lambda$; the majorant has lcm weight $3^{\omega(d)}$.
role: Finite analytic-consumption bridge. Direct consumer: MathlibNt.SieveTheory.LiuWeight.LiuPanCanonicalCoprimeTheorem.eventually_abs_liuSelbergRemainder_le. Admissibility includes support and |lambda|<=1, not normalization at 1. Full/noncoprime corrections are required before the even Selberg square is transported to Chen triples.

label: bp:foundation-fouvry-rectangle
title: Well-factorable rectangular Goldbach distribution
statement:
Fix $i,j,A\in\mathbb N$, $C_{m scale}\ge1$ and $\zeta>0$. There is a threshold $x_0$ depending only on these parameters such that for every real $x\ge x_0$ the bound $|\mathcal E_{m rect}|\le x/(\log x)^A$ holds uniformly in the following data: $M,T\ge1$, $4MT=x$, $T=x^
u$, $\zeta\le
u\le1/10+\zeta/10$; an integer residue $0<N\le C_{m scale}x$; a finite set $\mathcal U\subset[M,2M]\cap\mathbb N$ and interval $J=(u,v]\cap\mathbb N$ with $T\le u\le v\le2T$; coefficients $|\alpha(m)|\le	au_i(m)$ on $\mathcal U$, the short coefficient $ eta_N(n)=\mathbf1_{n\ 	ext{ prime},\,(n,N)=1}$, and a signed well-factorable coefficient $c$ of order $j$ at $Q=x^{(5-5
u)/9-\zeta}$. Here $	au_i$ is the ordered $i$-fold divisor function, and $\mathcal E_{m rect}$ is the signed sum over $1\le q\le\lfloor Qfloor$, $(q,N)=1$, of $c(q)$ times the $\alpha eta_N$ bilinear progression mass at $mn\equiv N\pmod q$ minus its coprime mass divided by $\varphi(q)$. The threshold precedes all rectangle, residue and coefficient choices.
role: Independent Li--Liu analytic producer. Direct consumers: G12LowRectangle.rectangle_C2_bound and G12FlexibleRectangle.rectangle_C2_bound. The integer residue is the actual N, with 0<N<=Cscale*x (Cscale>=1); no curved-region or outside-boundary estimate is asserted.

label: bp:chen-positive-weight
title: Positive weight detects at most two factors
statement: If $2\le z<y$, $1\le n<y^3$, no prime below $z$ divides $n$, and $w(n)>0$, then $n=1$, $n$ is prime, or $n=rs$ for primes $r,s\ge z$.

label: bp:chen-finite-counting
title: Chen finite counting inequality
statement: If $z<y$ and every corrected candidate complement is below $y^3$, then $|\mathcal C(N)|-(P(N)+T(N))/2\le|\mathcal C(N)\cap G(N)|$. The proof sums the pointwise weight bound.

label: bp:chen-lower-sieve
title: Lower Rosser density gives the actual base sieve
statement: The source lower-density lemma implies that for every $\delta>0$ some fixed $0<\epsilon<1/2$ gives $(f(5)-\delta)XV_N-\mathcal R_0(N,\epsilon)\le|\mathcal S(N)|$ eventually for even $N$. The actual finite remainder is retained.
role: lower sieve with unpaid distribution remainder

label: bp:chen-base-asymptotic
title: Distribution closes the base lower bound
statement: The base lower sieve and its Goldbach distribution estimate imply, for every $\eta>0$, $(8(\log4+J)-\eta)\mathcal X_N\le|\mathcal S(N)|$ eventually for even $N$. Mertens normalization is supplied internally.

label: bp:chen-finite-upper
title: Sum the conditioned finite upper sieves
statement: For $N>1$ and $\epsilon<1/60$, $H(N)\le\mathcal M_q(N,\epsilon)+\mathcal R_q(N,\epsilon)$, using exact conditioned sources and levels $d<\lfloor N^{1/2-\epsilon}/q\rfloor+1$.

label: bp:chen-weighted-bv
title: Pay combined-modulus weighted prime errors
statement: Ordinary BV implies that for each fixed $0<\epsilon<1/6$ and $A>0$ some $C>0$ gives $\sum_{q\in\mathcal Q(N),\ q\nmid N}\sum_{d\mid\mathcal P_N,\ d\le N^{1/2-\epsilon}/q}3^{\omega(d)}E_{\rm prime}(N,qd)\le CN/(\log N)^A$ eventually. Here $E_{\rm prime}(N,m)=\max_l|\pi(N;m,l)-L_*(N)/\varphi(m)|$ over canonical reduced residues, $L_*=\operatorname{li}_{2/\log2}$, and $E_{\rm prime}(N,m)\le E^*(N,m)$. Modulus zero has error zero and modulus one uses residue zero. The proof requests ordinary prefix-maximal saving $2A+10$.

label: bp:chen-upper-asymptotic
title: Close the varying-prime upper asymptotic
statement: The uniform upper density theorem and weighted BV imply, for every $\eta>0$, $H(N)\le(8(\log8+K/2)+\eta)\mathcal X_N$ eventually for even $N$. Prime partial summation is internal.

label: bp:chen-distinct-lower
title: Subtract half the medium-prime upper bound
statement: The base lower asymptotic and the two standard upper inputs imply $W_{\rm src}(N)\ge(2.6408-\eta)\mathcal X_N$ eventually for even $N$, for every $\eta>0$. The proof uses the exact source weight identity and the integral estimate.

label: bp:chen-prime-powers
title: Bound the proper-prime-power correction
statement: For even $N>2^{110}$, $P(N)\le\sum_{p\in\mathcal C(N)}\#\{r\in[z,y):r\text{ prime},\ r\mid N-p\}+60N^{9/10}$. Square-divisibility counts and a valuation bound pay the correction.

label: bp:chen-valuation-lower
title: Chen weighted lower bound
statement: The distinct source weighted lower bound implies $W(N)\ge(2.6408-\eta)\mathcal X_N$ eventually for even $N$, for every $\eta>0$. Source-boundary and valuation losses are absorbed using $\mathfrak S_{\mathrm{Liu}}(N)\ge U>0$.

label: bp:chen-triple-endpoints
title: Inject first-factor witnesses into source triples and endpoints
statement: For $N\ge1$ and $\lfloor N^{1/10}\rfloor\ge2$, $T(N)\le T_{\rm src}(N)+13N^{9/10}$. An injective selected-factor map isolates the two integer cutoff fibres.

label: bp:chen-square-majorant
title: A candidate prime contributes a unit Selberg packet
statement: For even $N$ and $R\ge1$, the corrected triple slice at a fixed pair is bounded by its optimal Selberg square sum plus the residual counting candidate primes $N-rsu\mid Q$. Away from this residual only divisor $1$ contributes.

label: bp:chen-square-expansion
title: Expand the square into progression counts
statement: For all $N,\epsilon,\lambda$, $\mathcal B_\lambda=\sum_{d_1,d_2\in\mathcal D}\lambda_{d_1}\lambda_{d_2}\sum_a b(a)\pi(N;a,[d_1,d_2],N\bmod[d_1,d_2])$. The proof is finite sum interchange and least-common-multiple divisibility.

label: bp:chen-square-main-term
title: Bound the optimized Selberg main term
statement: For every fixed $\kappa\ge0$ and $0<\epsilon\le10^{-10}$, eventually along even $N$, the optimal main term $H_{\kappa}(N)/\mathcal G$ is at most $3.94033\mathcal X_N$, where $H_{\kappa}(N)=\sum_a b(a)\operatorname{li}_{\kappa}(N/a)$. The actual source integral is $I_{\rm Liu}=\int_{1/10}^{1/3}\int_{1/3}^{(1-\alpha)/2}[\alpha\beta(1-\alpha-\beta)]^{-1}\,d\beta\,d\alpha<0.49254$. The producer transfers the exact reciprocal-log pair sum to this integral, then pays the genuine-li-minus-proxy correction to obtain $0\le H_{\kappa}(N)\le(0.49254+\eta)N/\log N$ for each fixed $\eta>0$ eventually. This is multiplied by the denominator estimate; the proof fixes $\delta=\eta=10^{-7}$.

label: bp:chen-switched-weight-payment
title: Pay the switched modulus weight by finite Cauchy
statement: One $C_9>0$, fixed before $\kappa,N,B$, bounds $(\sum_{q<L}\mu(q)^2 3^{\omega(q)}E_q(\kappa))^2$ by $C_9(\log(N+2))^9 C_\kappa N(1+\log N)^2\sum_{q<L}E_q(\kappa)$ for $N\ge2$, $\log N\ge1$, and $B\ge0$.

label: bp:chen-square-remainder
title: Pay the actual signed Selberg remainder
statement: Under the canonical coprime theorem, for every $\epsilon,A>0$, filter $\mathcal F\le\mathrm{atTop}$ and eventually admissible family $\lambda_N$, there is $C>0$ with $|\mathcal E_{\lambda_N}(N)|\le CN/(\log N)^A$ eventually in $\mathcal F$. The full majorant includes the noncoprime part.

label: bp:chen-triple-upper
title: Chen triple-penalty upper bound
statement: Under the canonical coprime theorem, for every $0<\epsilon\le10^{-10}$ and $A>0$ there is $C>0$ such that eventually for even $N$, $T(N)\le3.94033\mathcal X_N+CN/(\log N)^A$. Both cutoff and paper-modulus residuals are included.

label: bp:chen-representation-lower-bound
title: Chen: 0.67 representation bound
statement: For every sufficiently large even $N$, $0.67\,\mathfrak S_{\mathrm{Liu}}(N)N/(\log N)^2\le|G(N)|$, where $G(N)$ is the original set of primes $p<N$ with $N-p\ge2$ and at most two prime factors counted with multiplicity.

label: bp:chen-theorem
title: Chen prime plus at most two primes
statement: There exists $N_0\in\mathbb N$ such that every even $N\ge N_0$ admits $N=p+q$, with $p$ prime and either $q$ prime or $q=rs$ for primes $r,s$, which may coincide.

label: bp:liliu-representation
title: The literal asymmetric representation
statement: For $N,p\in\mathbb N$, the representation predicate is $p$ prime and $\exists r,q\in\mathbb N$: $(r=1\text{ or }r\text{ prime})$, $q$ prime, $N=p+rq$, and $r^{10}\le q^9$.

label: bp:liliu-count-positive
title: Positive distinct-prime count
statement: For every $N\in\mathbb N$, $D_{1,19/10}(N)>0$ if and only if there exist $p,r,q\in\mathbb N$ with $p\le N$, $p,q$ prime, $r=1$ or $r$ prime, $N=p+rq$, and $r^{10}\le q^9$.

label: bp:liliu-imbalance
title: The arithmetic imbalance mechanism
statement: For $N,n,r,q\in\mathbb N$ and $\varepsilon>0$, assume $r>0$, $n=rq>\varepsilon N$, $r<\lceil N^{9/19-\varepsilon}\rceil$, and $(N^{9/19-\varepsilon})^{19}\le(\varepsilon N)^9$. Then $r^{10}\le q^9$. The cutoff is equivalent to $r<N^{9/19-\varepsilon}$ because $r$ is integral.

label: bp:liliu-basic
title: Li–Liu finite weight detector
statement: For every fixed $\varepsilon>0$, there is $N_0\in\mathbb N$ such that, for all $N\ge N_0$ and every real $a$, $\sum_{n\in\mathcal A}w_a(n)\le D_{1,19/10}(N)$. The threshold precedes $a$; no evenness hypothesis is needed.

label: bp:liliu-six
title: Six-term sieve inequality with paid losses
statement: Fix $0<\varepsilon<2/15$. There is $N_0\in\mathbb N$ such that every even $N\ge N_0$ and every $1/21<k<\sigma\le1/3$, with $z=N^k,y=N^\sigma,T=N^{9/19-\varepsilon}$, satisfy $2S_1(z)-2S_2(T)-S_3(z,y)-2S_4(y)-S_5(z,y)+S_6(z,y)-446N^{1-k}\le2D_{1,19/10}(N)$. This threshold is uniform in $k,\sigma$; there is no additional positive-loss parameter.

label: bp:liliu-twelve
title: Li–Liu twelve-term decomposition
statement: Fix $0<\varepsilon<2/15$. One threshold works for every $1/18<a<b<(1-3b)/3<c<1/3$. With the corresponding cutoffs, every even $N$ beyond it satisfies $3G_1+G_2-4G_3-G_4-G_5+G_6+G_7-2G_8-G_9-G_{10}^{\mathrm{corr}}-G_{11}-G_{12}-1334N^{1-a}\le4D_{1,19/10}(N)$. In the analytic application $(a,b,c)=(4/53,4/33,3/11)$.

label: bp:liliu-sifted
title: Label-preserving output sifting
statement: For $N\ge2$, $\varepsilon>0$, $\beta>1/18$, any real second cutoff $C$, and $Z\ge1$, the finite labelled counts with first cutoff $B=N^\beta$ satisfy $\Pi_{10}\le\mathcal B_{10}(Z)+400\lfloor Z\rfloor$. Here the output $N-rsq$ is sifted excluding prime divisors of $N$, while the pair labels and strict prime-cofactor window are retained. Neither eventuality nor evenness is required.

label: bp:liliu-positive
title: The two positive lower-sieve terms
statement: For every $\delta>0$ and every fixed $0<\varepsilon<1$, there exists $N_0\ge4$ such that all even $N\ge N_0$ satisfy $((1-\varepsilon)L-\delta)\mathcal X_N\le3G_1+G_2$, at $(a,b)=(4/53,4/33)$. The threshold may depend on both $\delta$ and $\varepsilon$; epsilon need not shrink with delta.

label: bp:liliu-retained
title: Li–Liu five-term reduction
statement: For every $\delta>0$, there exists $\varepsilon_0\in(0,2/15]$ such that, for every fixed $0<\varepsilon<\varepsilon_0$, there is $N_0(\delta,\varepsilon)\ge4$ for which all even $N\ge N_0$ satisfy $G_6+G_7-G_9-G_{11}-G_{12}+(124341093/200000000-\delta)\mathcal X_N\le4D_{1,19/10}(N)$, at the fixed exponents of this chapter.

label: bp:liliu-b9
title: The original ninth count and its split integral
statement: For every $\delta>0$ and every fixed $0<\varepsilon<2/15$, there is $N_0\ge4$ such that all even $N\ge N_0$ satisfy $G_9\le(C_9+\delta)\mathcal X_N$, with $G_9=S_5(N^{4/53},N^{1/3})$. The threshold follows $\delta,\varepsilon$. The low part of $C_9$ retains the additional factor $1/(1-u)$, so its reduced kernel has denominator $u(1-u)^2$.

label: bp:liliu-pair
title: Original positive pair counts
statement: For every $\delta>0$, there exists $\varepsilon_0\in(0,2/15]$ such that, for every fixed $0<\varepsilon<\varepsilon_0$, there is $N_0(\delta,\varepsilon)\ge4$ for which all even $N\ge N_0$ satisfy $(C_{67}-\delta)\mathcal X_N\le G_6+G_7$, at $(a,b,c)=(4/53,4/33,3/11)$. The small epsilon window absorbs the source-mass loss before the natural threshold is chosen.

label: bp:liliu-pair-certificate
title: Certified lower bound for the pair integral

label: bp:liliu-level
title: The author weight from the actual mixed level
statement: For $N\ge4$, $N^{4/53}\ge4$, $1<\rho\le5/4$, and $0\le\eta<1/4$, every used grid cell and every short prime $p$ in it satisfy $4\log N/\log Q_{\mathrm{mix}}\le h(\log p/\log N)+32\eta$. The finite comparison has arbitrary real $\varepsilon$, constrained only through membership in the used-cell set; $\eta$ is the level loss, not a small-epsilon-window parameter.

label: bp:liliu-domain
title: Matching the author original ordered domain

label: bp:liliu-g11-actual
title: Eleventh-term count upper bound
statement: For every $\delta>0$ and every fixed $0<\varepsilon\le1$, there exists $N_0(\delta,\varepsilon)\ge4$ such that all even $N\ge N_0$ satisfy $G_{11}\le(10191/100000+\delta)\mathcal X_N$ on the original domain $z\le r\le q\le s\le t\le B$. No factor $1-\varepsilon$ is asserted: this bound uses the full upper-endpoint rough mother.

label: bp:liliu-cross
title: The original cross count after both exception payments
statement: For every $\delta>0$ and every fixed $0<\varepsilon\le2/15$, there exists $N_0(\delta,\varepsilon)\ge4$ such that all even $N\ge N_0$ satisfy $G_{12}\le(C_{12}+\delta)\mathcal X_N$. Both exception payments are included. The original domain is $z\le r\le q\le s\le B\le t\le C$, and $C_{12}$ uses the strict-low, closed-high Buchstab-weight split defined in the text.

label: bp:liliu-author-consume
title: Author estimate consumed at the original counts
statement: For every $\delta>0$, there exists $\varepsilon_0\in(0,2/15]$ such that, for every fixed $0<\varepsilon<\varepsilon_0$, there is $N_0(\delta,\varepsilon)\ge4$ for which all even $N\ge N_0$ satisfy $G_6+G_7-G_{12}+(c_0-C_9-10191/100000-\delta)\mathcal X_N\le4D_{1,19/10}(N)$, at the fixed exponents of this chapter.

label: bp:liliu-ledger
title: Li–Liu positive total weight
statement: For every $\delta>0$, there is $\varepsilon_0\in(0,2/15]$ such that, for every fixed $0<\varepsilon<\varepsilon_0$, there exists $N_0(\delta,\varepsilon)\ge4$ for which all even $N\ge N_0$ satisfy $(515093/200000000-\delta)\mathcal X_N\le4D_{1,19/10}(N)$. The threshold is not asserted uniformly over all small positive epsilon.

label: bp:liliu-coefficient
title: Every fixed coefficient below the retained ceiling
statement: $\forall\kappa<515093/800000000\ \exists K\ge4\ \forall N\ge K,\ 2\mid N\Rightarrow\kappa \mathcal X_N\le D_{1,19/10}(N)$.

label: bp:liliu-paper
title: Li–Liu: strict 0.0004 lower bound
statement: $\exists K\ge4\ \forall N\ge K,\ 2\mid N\Rightarrow 0.0004\mathcal X_N<D_{1,19/10}(N)$.

label: bp:liliu-old-margin
title: The separate earlier positive margin
statement: For $m_{\mathrm{old}}:=4J_{\mathrm{elem}}+c_0-C_9-10385101/10^8-C_{12}$, where $J_{\mathrm{elem}}$ is the five fixed sum-coordinate integrals in the text (including the half-square multiplicity), $126891/200000000\le m_{\mathrm{old}}$. This is an unconditional scalar certificate with no epsilon parameter, not the definition of the margin and not the author-route ledger.

label: bp:liliu-existence
title: The actual unconditional existence endpoint
statement: There exists $K\ge4$ such that every even $N\ge K$ admits $p,r,q\in\mathbb N$ with $p\le N$, $p,q$ prime, $r=1$ or $r$ prime, $N=p+rq$, and $r\le q^{(19/10)-1}$. This endpoint is supplied by the independent old-margin existence route.

label: bp:foundation-bv-low
title: Small-conductor Siegel–Walfisz input
statement: The constructed smoothing function and the proved uniform Landau--Siegel lower bound supply the nonprincipal primitive Siegel--Walfisz estimate required by the ordinary BV producer.
role: Small-conductor branch of ordinary prime distribution

label: bp:foundation-bv-high
title: Large-conductor Vaughan estimates
statement: For each requested logarithmic saving, one common pair of Vaughan cutoffs pays the Type I, Type II and small-term means on the chosen high-conductor family, including the prefix and cofactor amplification factors.
role: Large-conductor branch of ordinary prime distribution
